You could have heard a pin drop.

Think about the contrast. The 81-year-old metalworker who just fought off the full weight of Silicon Valley algorithms, US-backed oligarchs, and massive disinformation campaigns is sending warmth and love to the people.

Meanwhile, the man who lost the election fled to Miami to hide from justice, and wrote a delusional letter first claiming "true president-elect of Brazil" and then when he understood that everyone knows you lost. deleted it and claimed "true leader" while misspelling his own country's name with an English Z.
